images.title: Unfold the box, keep the length
images.purpose: Shows the core move of the path unfolder tool: the box is unfolded, the path keeps its length, and on the net the shortest path is a straight line.
images.composition: Plain white background with generous empty margins; the main object is large and centred and fills about 60 percent of the frame; nothing else is drawn. Before and after in one row: the closed cube on the left, a thick grey arrow, the two flat faces on the right.
images.exact_structure: Left: a cube drawn flat in a simple corner view, thin dark outlines, white faces, side 4 units, showing front, top and right faces. Ant: a small dark dot at the centre of the front face. Laddu: an amber #E69F00 dot at the centre of the top face. A thick green #009E73 path from the ant straight up to the top front edge and then straight back across the top face to the laddu. Centre: a thick grey arrow pointing right with 'unfold' above it. Right: two equal squares of side 4 units, the top face directly above the front face, sharing a dashed grey fold line. The ant dot at the centre of the lower square, the laddu dot at the centre of the upper square, and a thick green straight vertical line between them labelled '4 cm'. Small labels 'ant' and 'laddu' beside the dots on the right only. Nothing else.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Unfolding keeps every length, so the straight line on the net is the shortest path on the box.
images.description: Shows the core move of the path unfolder tool: the box is unfolded, the path keeps its length, and on the net the shortest path is a straight line.
images.context: Concept T9.C4; one image that shows only the main idea.
images.teaching_notes: Cube side 4 cm: ant 2 cm below the fold, laddu 2 cm above it, 2 + 2 = 4 cm.

image_decisions.why: The practice tool unfolds a box and draws a line; showing that one move in its simplest case is the core skill.
